basic_details.job_title: NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I position (on contract basis) is open in the Department of Architecture & Planning at the National Institute of Technology Calicut, for the research project "Operational Framework for Non-Biodegradable Waste Management in Kozhikode Municipal Corporation", sponsored by the Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning & Design, NITC. The engagement is for 11 months, with consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA for JRF or Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA for Project Associate I. Candidates need a First Class Master's degree in Architecture or Planning or E

how_to_apply: Fill the registration form given with the notice (as annexed).
Keep ready the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification/experience.
Consolidate the filled form and all soft copies into a single PDF document.
E-mail the PDF to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected].
Write the subject line "Application for "Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I"".
Send the application by the last date, 10 December 2026.
Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience
No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)
important_instructions: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photograph submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The No Objection Certificate applies only to applicants already in employment, in government or any other organization.

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Calicut (Office of Research and Consultancy)
Operational Framework for Non-Biodegradable Waste Management in Kozhikode Municipal Corporation
Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning & Design, NITC
JRF: Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA; Project Associate I: Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA
Department of Architecture & Planning, NIT Calicut

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single position is filled either at the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) level or at the Project Associate I level, depending on the candidate's qualification. The notice lists the two essential qualifications as alternatives, joined by "OR". The difference between the two levels is the GATE requirement: the JRF level needs a qualified GATE in Architecture and Planning/Civil Engineering, while the Project Associate I level does not ask for GATE. Age limit: The notice prints the age limit as "40". No cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation are given in the notice. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Architecture or Planning or Environmental Engineering from a recognised University with First Class and B.Arch/B.Tech (Civil or equivalent) with First Class and Qualified GATE in Architecture and Planning/Civil Engineering
Master's degree in Architecture or Planning or Environmental Engineering from a recognised University with First Class and B.Arch/B.Tech (Civil or equivalent) with First Class

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is consolidated, with 20% HRA on top of the stated amount at both levels. The engagement is on contract basis for 11 months, with extension based on the performance of the candidate and availability of the project fund.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form given with the notice (as annexed). Keep ready the most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification/experience. Consolidate the filled form and all soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail the PDF to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Write the subject line "Application for "Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I"". Send the application by the last date, 10 December 2026. Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organization)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After shortlisting, the eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview will be held online on 14 December 2026. Applicants who are already in employment must submit the No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview along with the documents mentioned above.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photograph submitted. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The No Objection Certificate applies only to applicants already in employment, in government or any other organization.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 for JRF/Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is 1 position of Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I in the Department of Architecture & Planning.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIT Calicut JRF post?
faq.answer: JRF needs a Master's degree in Architecture or Planning or Environmental Engineering with First Class, B.Arch/B.Tech (Civil or equivalent) with First Class and a qualified GATE in Architecture and Planning/Civil Engineering. Project Associate I needs the same degrees without GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as 40.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Calicut JRF and Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA for JRF and Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA for Project Associate I.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% HRA is paid in addition to the consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000/- (JRF) or Rs. 30,000/- (Project Associate I).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the annexed registration form, combine it with your latest CV and mark sheets/certificates into a single PDF, and email it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should be used in the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for "Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-I"".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted, notified by email and invited for an online interview scheduled on 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NIT Calicut JRF/Project Associate-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract basis for 11 months, with extension based on the performance of the candidate and availability of the project fund.
